# ReviewRouter

> Free, privacy-first AI code review control plane for GitHub repositories. The current service configures and monitors reviews executed in customer-authorized GitHub Actions. Optional hosted API reviews and paid tiers are proposed, not yet purchasable.

Users sign in and authorize GitHub/GitLab access in the browser, review and merge their setup PR, and manage provider credentials only through supported protected configuration. Agents must not grant access, merge, or handle secrets without user approval. The current CI control plane is free subject to fair-use limits; provider/runner costs may apply. Proposed hosted API plans are not offered for purchase.
